authored_assumptions: This is a new authored 3D interpretation of the existing original fox design, not recovered geometry or a neural text-to-3D result.
Complete hidden surfaces and twenty-bone rest layout are authored; the original fox left/right bone names are preserved as identifiers.
The continuous arm and leg lofts use explicit multi-bone skin blends around elbows and knees; they are not muscle or cloth simulations.
The shoulder roots are rounded and buried within the torso, with torso/arm weight blending; skin is not a single watertight anatomical retopology.
The scarf, eyelids, fingers and face are sculpted fixed geometry without independent expressions or cloth dynamics.
The book drawings and pencil strokes remain authored gestures: no new ink or page simulation is claimed.
This PBR browser-quality variant is separate from Weft's restricted diffuse-only importer profile.
The preserved four skeletal actions are authored animation, not learned behavior or Weft physics.
The fox iris remains its original glossy colored geometry: a radial iris map is not applied to an incompatible latitude/longitude UV sphere.

HD textures are seeded, locally authored procedural patterns at native1024/2048 resolution, not neural output, reference-extracted texture maps or evidence of photorealism. Studio floor and exposure are render settings, not simulation geometry.

Plush browser fur remains5,000 six-vertex alpha-masked skinned hair cards; the separately configured native Blender groom has5,000 parents and30 children, a155,000-fiber upper bound, not an exported GLB strand count.

The native groom length is1.6times the v1 length capped at0.035m, and browser ribbons are1.4times longer and1.25times wider. No hair dynamics, recovered real groom or measured animal anatomy is claimed.
Only the same twenty furry coat/cream/dark skin surfaces receive hair. Inner ears, eyes, nose, accessories and tools remain bare; no separate forelock geometry is invented.
The plush studio changes render lighting and contrast only. Its floor stays at the previous authored rest height; it is not collision geometry or a physical contact solver.
Native hair is authored into directional rest-space curves, retaining the emitter skin; there is no dynamic hair simulation. The GLB contains its separate masked-card coat.

fur_representation.native: editable native groom with per-material cutout visibility

initialization.method: Particle Edit enter/exit on owned emitter

limitations: Apply once to a fresh groom in its rest pose; counts/topology changes can regenerate hair.
The vector is in emitter object axes; no panda-specific direction or recovered grooming.
Stored parent arc length is preserved; interpolated render paths can add configured roughness/clump variation.
Native Blender hair is not exported as glTF geometry or browser hair.
Material uses the source base-color value, not sampled texture colors; use separate material regions.
Hair follows the copied emitter's same armature; keep emitter topology unchanged after grooming.
The caller caps aggregate fibers at 240000 and excludes native groom objects from GLB selection.

native_parameters.root_radius_description: Strand diameter width at the root

uv_repair.method: Per-loop geometric-plane UV projection for collapsed UVs or cancelling UV fans; other UV seams unchanged. Tangents are computed by Blender MikkTSpace, not replaced.

attachments.placement: Held against left paw, visible in front of chest.

rights: New locally authored shapes/materials; reference resemblance is not independent rights verification

states.meaning: Quiet attentive breathing, alternating ear twitches and a slow tail sway.
Looks down at the sketchbook and draws a craft pattern with several short pencil strokes.
Raises both paws clearly above shoulder level, displaying the sketchbook and pencil during one delighted hop, then returns to rest.
Raises the sketchbook toward its face and reads it with a pronounced downward gaze and slow page scan; pencil hand stays resting.

style: Detailed warm storybook fox: soft short fur, expressive eyes, tailored teal scarf and crafted props; native-HD procedural surface and grounded-studio edition; denser plush-fur revision
subject: A small red fox craftsperson with a sea-green scarf, a blue sketchbook and a golden pencil.
